```
<section class="page-intro">

    <div>
      <h2>About DHAKATHAI ALCOMAXX PLC</h2>
      <p>We are a dynamic, passionate, and industry-leading team committed to excellence in aluminium extrusion. Since our inception in 1997, we have grown into Bangladesh&rsquo;s largest single manufacturer of aluminium profiles, operating with eight advanced extrusion presses. Our journey has been defined by innovation, quality, and an unwavering dedication to serving diverse industries, including architecture, transportation, hardware, and industrial applications.</p>
      <p><strong>What We Produce</strong> &mdash; Our cutting-edge extrusion lines manufacture a comprehensive range of aluminium profiles tailored for windows, doors, LED lighting, ladders, pipes, curtain walls, and much more. We offer premium finishes, including anodized (silver, champagne, bronze, black, and various customized colors), powder coating, and wood grain textures in various shades &mdash; ensuring durability, aesthetics, and superior quality in every product.</p>
      <p><strong>Who We Serve</strong> &mdash; With an extensive dealer network across Bangladesh, we have established ourselves as the preferred choice for high-quality aluminium solutions. We are proudly enlisted with esteemed organizations such as the Military Engineering Services (MES), Public Works Department (PWD), The Aluminum Association, Aluminium Extruders Council, BUET, and numerous developers and REHAB member companies.</p>
```

```
import { useModal } from '~/composables/useModal'
import { wirePageInteractions } from '~/composables/useLegacyInteractions'
import { watch, onMounted, nextTick } from 'vue'

const { state } = useModal()
const route = useRoute()

watch(() => state.lightbox.open || state.pdf.open || state.video.open, (anyOpen) => {
  document.body.style.overflow = anyOpen ? 'hidden' : ''
})

onMounted(() => wirePageInteractions())
watch(() => route.fullPath, () => nextTick(() => wirePageInteractions()))

function onKeydown(e: KeyboardEvent) {
  if (e.key === 'Escape') {
    state.lightbox.open = false
    state.pdf.open = false
    state.video.open = false
  }
}

onMounted(() => window.addEventListener('keydown', onKeydown))
onBeforeUnmount(() => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeydown))
</script>
```

```
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, nextTick, onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, ref, watch } from 'vue'
import { useRoute } from 'vue-router'

const route = useRoute()
const isOpen = ref(false)
const openSection = ref('')
const scrolled = ref(false)

const pageName = computed(() => (route.path === '/' ? 'index.html' : route.path.replace(/^\//, '') + '.html'))

const sectionPaths: Record<string, string[]> = {
  products: ['products-architectural', 'products-industrial', 'products-furniture', 'products-hardware', 'products-electrical', 'products-others', 'online-catalogue', 'catalogue'],
  projects: ['projects-image', 'projects-list', 'projects-video'],
  manufacturing: ['manufacturing-billet-casting', 'manufacturing-extrusion-presses', 'manufacturing-aging-tempering-oven', 'manufacturing-anodizing-section', 'manufacturing-powder-coating-plant', 'manufacturing-wooden-finish', 'manufacturing-quality-inspection', 'manufacturing-packaging', 'manufacturing-warehousing-and-delivery', 'manufacturing-etp'],
  investors: ['board-of-directors']
}

function isActive(to: string) {
  if (to === '/') return route.path === '/'
  return route.path === to
}

function sectionHasPage(section: string) {
  return (sectionPaths[section] || []).some((p) => pageName.value === p + '.html')
}

watch(pageName, () => {
  for (const s of Object.keys(sectionPaths)) {
    if (sectionHasPage(s)) {
      openSection.value = s
      return
    }
  }
  openSection.value = ''
}, { immediate: true })

function onMenuCapture(e: MouseEvent) {
  if (window.innerWidth > 820) return
  const el = (e.target as HTMLElement | null)?.closest('[data-accordion]') as HTMLElement | null
  if (!el) return
  const name = el.getAttribute('data-accordion') || ''
  if (openSection.value !== name) {
    e.preventDefault()
    e.stopPropagation()
    openSection.value = name
  }
}

function openMenu() {
  isOpen.value = true
  document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden'
  nextTick(() => {
    const close = document.querySelector('.drawer-close') as HTMLButtonElement | null
    close?.focus()
  })
}

function closeMenu() {
  isOpen.value = false
  document.body.style.overflow = ''
}

function onKeydown(e: KeyboardEvent) {
  if (e.key === 'Escape') closeMenu()
}

function onResize() {
  if (window.innerWidth > 820) {
    if (isOpen.value) closeMenu()
    openSection.value = ''
  }
}

function onScroll() {
  scrolled.value = window.scrollY > 10
}

onMounted(() => {
  window.addEventListener('keydown', onKeydown)
  window.addEventListener('resize', onResize)
  window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll)
  onScroll()
})

onBeforeUnmount(() => {
  window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeydown)
  window.removeEventListener('resize', onResize)
  window.removeEventListener('scroll', onScroll)
  document.body.style.overflow = ''
})
</script>
```

```
  <script>
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
    if (typeof window.DEALERS === "undefined") return;
    var dealers = window.DEALERS;
    var districts = [];
    dealers.forEach(function (x) {
      if (districts.indexOf(x.d) === -1) districts.push(x.d);
    });
    districts.sort();

    var filterWrap = document.getElementById("dealerFilters");
    districts.forEach(function (d) {
      var b = document.createElement("button");
      b.className = "btn btn-dark filter-btn";
      b.setAttribute("data-filter", d);
      b.textContent = d;
      filterWrap.appendChild(b);
    });

    var body = document.getElementById("dealerBody");
    function render(filter, query) {
      body.innerHTML = "";
      var n = 0;
      dealers.forEach(function (x) {
        if (filter !== "all" && x.d !== filter) return;
        if (query && (x.d + " " + x.r + " " + x.m).toLowerCase().indexOf(query) === -1) return;
        var tr = document.createElement("tr");
        tr.className = "dealer-row";
        tr.setAttribute("data-district", x.d);
        tr.innerHTML = "<td><b>" + x.d + "</b></td><td>" + x.r + "</td><td class='num'>" + x.m + "</td>";
        body.appendChild(tr);
        n++;
      });
      document.getElementById("dealerCount").textContent = "Showing " + n + " of " + dealers.length + " dealer routes across Bangladesh.";
    }

    var activeFilter = "all";
    filterWrap.querySelectorAll(".filter-btn").forEach(function (btn) {
      btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
        filterWrap.querySelectorAll(".filter-btn").forEach(function (b) { b.classList.remove("active"); });
        btn.classList.add("active");
        activeFilter = btn.getAttribute("data-filter");
        render(activeFilter, document.getElementById("dealerSearch").value.toLowerCase());
      });
    });
    document.getElementById("dealerSearch").addEventListener("input", function () {
      render(activeFilter, this.value.toLowerCase());
    });

    render("all", "");
  });
  </script>
</template>
```

```
<script setup lang="ts">
import type { CatalogProduct } from '~/data/catalog'

useHead({
  title: 'Online Catalogue',
  meta: [{ name: 'description', content: 'Browse DHAKATHAI ALCOMAXX PLC aluminium profiles - search by die number, profile name or category with product images and specifications.' }]
})

const { catalog } = await import('~/data/catalog')

const SUB_CHUNK = 60
const FLAT_CHUNK = 200

const searchQuery = ref('')
const currentView = ref<'cat' | 'subs' | 'flat'>('cat')
const openCategories = ref<Set<string>>(new Set(catalog.categories.length ? [catalog.categories[0].name] : []))
const renderedCategories = ref<Set<string>>(new Set(catalog.categories.length ? [catalog.categories[0].name] : []))
const flatLimit = ref(FLAT_CHUNK)
const subLimits = ref<Record<string, number>>({})

const query = computed(() => searchQuery.value.trim().toLowerCase())

function matches(p: CatalogProduct) {
  if (!query.value) return true
  return (p.name + ' ' + p.die + ' ' + p.id + ' ' + p.cat + ' ' + p.sub).toLowerCase().includes(query.value)
}

function categoryProducts(name: string) {
  return catalog.products.filter(p => p.cat === name && matches(p))
}

function categoryVisible(name: string) {
  if (name.toLowerCase().includes(query.value)) return true
  return categoryProducts(name).length > 0
}

const subsCategories = computed(() =>
  catalog.categories
    .filter(c => categoryVisible(c.name))
    .map(c => ({ name: c.name, count: c.count, letter: c.name.charAt(0) }))
)

function subsFor(name: string) {
  const out: { name: string; products: CatalogProduct[] }[] = []
  const index: Record<string, number> = {}
  for (const p of catalog.products) {
    if (p.cat !== name || !matches(p)) continue
    if (index[p.sub] === undefined) {
      index[p.sub] = out.length
      out.push({ name: p.sub, products: [] })
    }
    out[index[p.sub]].products.push(p)
  }
  return out
}

const flatProducts = computed(() => catalog.products.filter(p => matches(p)))
const flatSlice = computed(() => flatProducts.value.slice(0, flatLimit.value))

function subKey(catName: string, subName: string) {
  return catName + '|' + subName
}

function subLimit(catName: string, subName: string) {
  return subLimits.value[subKey(catName, subName)] || SUB_CHUNK
}

function subRemaining(catName: string, subName: string, total: number) {
  return Math.max(0, total - subLimit(catName, subName))
}

function loadMoreSub(catName: string, subName: string) {
  subLimits.value = {
    ...subLimits.value,
    [subKey(catName, subName)]: subLimit(catName, subName) + SUB_CHUNK
  }
}

function isCategoryOpen(name: string) {
  return openCategories.value.has(name)
}

function isCategoryRendered(name: string) {
  return renderedCategories.value.has(name)
}

function toggleCategory(name: string) {
  const open = new Set(openCategories.value)
  const rendered = new Set(renderedCategories.value)
  if (open.has(name)) {
    open.delete(name)
  } else {
    open.add(name)
    rendered.add(name)
  }
  openCategories.value = open
  renderedCategories.value = rendered
}

function switchView(view: 'cat' | 'subs' | 'flat') {
  currentView.value = view
  if (view === 'flat') flatLimit.value = FLAT_CHUNK
}

function loadMoreFlat() {
  flatLimit.value += FLAT_CHUNK
}

function goToCategory(name: string) {
  currentView.value = 'cat'
  const open = new Set(openCategories.value)
  const rendered = new Set(renderedCategories.value)
  open.add(name)
  rendered.add(name)
  openCategories.value = open
  renderedCategories.value = rendered
  nextTick(() => {
    for (const item of Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.cat-acc-item'))) {
      if (item.getAttribute('data-cat') === name) {
        item.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' })
        break
      }
    }
  })
}

watch(searchQuery, () => {
  flatLimit.value = FLAT_CHUNK
  subLimits.value = {}
})
</script>

<template>
  <section class="page-hero">
    <div class="crumbs"><NuxtLink to="/">Home</NuxtLink> &raquo; Catalogue</div>
    <div class="container">
      <span class="kicker">Online Catalogue</span>
      <h1>Aluminium Profile Catalogue</h1>
      <p>Browse all aluminium profiles by die number, name or category.</p>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="section">
    <div class="container">

      <div class="cat-toolbar">
        <div class="cat-search">
          <input type="search" id="cat-filter" v-model="searchQuery" class="form-control" placeholder="Filter by die number, name, item ID or category...">
        </div>
        <div class="cat-view-pills" role="group" aria-label="View type">
          <button type="button" class="cat-view-pill" :class="{ active: currentView === 'cat' }" data-view="cat" @click="switchView('cat')">Category</button>
          <button type="button" class="cat-view-pill" :class="{ active: currentView === 'subs' }" data-view="subs" @click="switchView('subs')">Categories Only</button>
          <button type="button" class="cat-view-pill" :class="{ active: currentView === 'flat' }" data-view="flat" @click="switchView('flat')">Flat List</button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div id="view-cat" :class="{ 'd-none': currentView !== 'cat' }">
        <div id="cat-accordion">
          <div
            v-for="cat in catalog.categories"
            :key="cat.name"
            class="cat-acc-item"
            :data-cat="cat.name"
            :style="categoryVisible(cat.name) ? undefined : { display: 'none' }"
          >
            <button
              class="cat-acc-btn"
              :class="{ collapsed: !isCategoryOpen(cat.name) }"
              type="button"
              :aria-expanded="String(isCategoryOpen(cat.name))"
              @click="toggleCategory(cat.name)"
            >
              <span class="cat-acc-title">{{ cat.name }}</span>
              <span class="cat-acc-count">{{ cat.count }}</span>
              <span class="cat-acc-arrow"></span>
            </button>
            <div class="cat-acc-body" :style="isCategoryOpen(cat.name) ? { display: 'block' } : undefined">
              <div class="cat-grid" data-grid>
                <template v-if="isCategoryRendered(cat.name)">
                  <div v-for="sub in subsFor(cat.name)" :key="sub.name" class="cat-sub-block">
                    <div class="cat-sub-head"><span class="cat-chip">{{ sub.name }}</span><span class="cat-chip-count">{{ sub.products.length }}</span></div>
                    <div class="cat-grid">
                      <CatalogCard v-for="p in sub.products.slice(0, subLimit(cat.name, sub.name))" :key="p.id" :product="p" />
                    </div>
                    <div v-if="subRemaining(cat.name, sub.name, sub.products.length) > 0" class="cat-more">
                      <button type="button" class="btn btn-dark" @click="loadMoreSub(cat.name, sub.name)">Load more ({{ subRemaining(cat.name, sub.name, sub.products.length) }} remaining)</button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div v-if="subsFor(cat.name).length === 0" class="cat-empty">No profiles in this category.</div>
                </template>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div id="view-subs" :class="{ 'd-none': currentView !== 'subs' }">
        <div class="cat-grid cat-grid-subs" id="subs-grid">
          <div v-for="cat in subsCategories" :key="cat.name" class="cat-col cat-col-subs">
            <a class="cat-quick" href="#cat-accordion" :data-goto="cat.name" @click.prevent="goToCategory(cat.name)">
              <span class="cat-q-icon">{{ cat.letter }}</span>
              <span class="cat-q-body">
                <span class="cat-q-name">{{ cat.name }}</span>
                <span class="cat-q-count">{{ cat.count }} profiles</span>
              </span>
            </a>
          </div>
          <div v-if="subsCategories.length === 0" class="cat-empty">No categories found.</div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div id="view-flat" :class="{ 'd-none': currentView !== 'flat' }">
        <div class="cat-grid" id="flat-grid">
          <CatalogCard v-for="p in flatSlice" :key="p.id" :product="p" />
          <div v-if="flatSlice.length === 0" class="cat-empty">No profiles found.</div>
        </div>
        <div class="cat-more" id="flat-more-wrap" :class="{ 'd-none': flatLimit >= flatProducts.length }">
          <button type="button" class="btn btn-dark" id="flat-more" @click="loadMoreFlat">Load more</button>
        </div>
      </div>

    </div>
  </section>
</template>

```

```
  barisal: 'Barisal',
  chittagong: 'Chittagong'
}

const allDealers = computed(() => Object.values(divisionDealers).flatMap(d => d.dealers))
const hasDivision = computed(() => !!activeDivision.value)

const divisionList = computed(() =>
  Object.keys(divisionDealers).map(key => ({
    key,
    label: divisionLabels[key] || divisionDealers[key].label,
    count: divisionDealers[key].dealers.length
  }))
)

const divisionDealerList = computed(() =>
  activeDivision.value ? divisionDealers[activeDivision.value]?.dealers || [] : []
)

const areaList = computed(() => {
  const counts = new Map<string, number>()
  for (const d of divisionDealerList.value) {
    const area = d.area || 'Others'
    counts.set(area, (counts.get(area) || 0) + 1)
  }
  return [...counts.entries()]
    .sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1] || a[0].localeCompare(b[0]))
    .map(([area, count]) => ({ area, count }))
})

const filteredDealers = computed(() => {
  const q = searchQuery.value.trim().toLowerCase()
  const scope = hasDivision.value ? divisionDealerList.value : allDealers.value
  return scope.filter(d => {
    if (activeArea.value && (d.area || 'Others') !== activeArea.value) return false
    if (q && !(d.customer + ' ' + d.person + ' ' + d.address + ' ' + d.phone).toLowerCase().includes(q)) return false
    return true
  })
})

const totalInScope = computed(() => divisionDealerList.value.length)

function selectDivision(key: string) {
  activeDivision.value = key
  activeArea.value = ''
  searchQuery.value = ''
}

function selectArea(area: string) {
  activeArea.value = activeArea.value === area ? '' : area
}

function clearDivision() {
  activeDivision.value = ''
  activeArea.value = ''
  searchQuery.value = ''
}

function clearArea() {
  activeArea.value = ''
}

function digits(v: string) {
  return v.replace(/\D/g, '')
}
function telLink(v: string) {
  const d = digits(v)
  return d.length >= 10 ? 'tel:' + d : ''
}
function waLink(v: string) {
  const d = digits(v)
  if (d.length < 10) return ''
  if (d.startsWith('880')) return 'https://wa.me/' + d
  if (d.startsWith('0')) return 'https://wa.me/880' + d.slice(1)
  return 'https://wa.me/880' + d
}

function onMapMessage(e: MessageEvent) {
  const d = e.data as any
  if (d && d.type === 'dtl-division') selectDivision(d.key)
}

onMounted(() => {
  window.addEventListener('message', onMapMessage)
})
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
  window.removeEventListener('message', onMapMessage)
})
</script>

                <b>{{ d.customer }}</b>

                  <a v-if="waLink(d.phone)" :href="waLink(d.phone)" target="_blank" rel="noopener" class="btn-whatsapp-sm">WhatsApp</a>
```

```
        return route.path === to

      function sectionHasPage(section: string) {
        return (sectionPaths[section] || []).some((p) => pageName.value === p + '.html')
      }
      
      watch(pageName, () => {
        for (const s of Object.keys(sectionPaths)) {
          if (sectionHasPage(s)) {
            openSection.value = s
            return
          }
        }
        openSection.value = ''
      }, { immediate: true })
      
      function onMenuCapture(e: MouseEvent) {
        if (window.innerWidth > 820) return
        const el = (e.target as HTMLElement | null)?.closest('[data-accordion]') as HTMLElement | null
        if (!el) return
        const name = el.getAttribute('data-accordion') || ''
        if (openSection.value !== name) {
          e.preventDefault()
          e.stopPropagation()
          openSection.value = name
        }
      }
      
      function openMenu() {
        isOpen.value = true
        document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden'
        nextTick(() => {
          const close = document.querySelector('.drawer-close') as HTMLButtonElement | null
          close?.focus()
        })
      }
      
      function closeMenu() {
        isOpen.value = false
        document.body.style.overflow = ''
      }
      
      function onKeydown(e: KeyboardEvent) {
        if (e.key === 'Escape') closeMenu()
      }
      
      function onResize() {
        if (window.innerWidth > 820) {
          if (isOpen.value) closeMenu()
          openSection.value = ''
        }
      }
      
      function onScroll() {
        scrolled.value = window.scrollY > 10
      }
      
      onMounted(() => {
        window.addEventListener('keydown', onKeydown)
        window.addEventListener('resize', onResize)
        window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll)
        onScroll()
      })
      
      onBeforeUnmount(() => {
        window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeydown)
        window.removeEventListener('resize', onResize)
        window.removeEventListener('scroll', onScroll)
        document.body.style.overflow = ''
      })
      </script>
```

```
      }
      
      img { max-width: 100%; display: block; }
      
      a { color: var(--primary-light); text-decoration: none; }
      a:hover { color: var(--accent); }
      
      h1, h2, h3, h4, h5 { font-family: var(--font-head); color: var(--primary); line-height: 1.25; }
      
      .container { width: 100%; max-width: 1400px; padding: 0 20px; margin-inline: auto; }
      
      /* ============ TOP BAR ============ */
      .topbar {
        background: var(--primary-dark);
        color: #cbd6e2;
        font-size: 0.85rem;
        padding: 7px 0;
      }
      .topbar .container { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
      .topbar a { color: #cbd6e2; }
      .topbar a:hover { color: var(--accent-light); }
      .topbar-left { display: flex; gap: 18px; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
      .topbar-right { display: flex; gap: 14px; align-items: center; }
      
      /* ============ HEADER / NAV ============ */
      .header {
        position: sticky;
        top: 0;
        z-index: 1000;
        width: 100%;
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.92);
        backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
        box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04);
        transition: var(--transition);
      }
      .header.scrolled {
        box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.98);
      }
      .nav {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: space-between;
        gap: 20px;
        padding: 14px 0;
        width: 100%;
      }
      .brand {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 14px;
        min-width: 0;
        flex-shrink: 0;
      }
      .brand img { height: 52px; width: auto; }
      
      .nav-menu {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 6px;
        list-style: none;
        margin-left: auto;
        flex-shrink: 1;
        min-width: 0;
      }
      .nav-menu > li { position: relative; }
      .nav-menu > li > a {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 8px;
        padding: 10px 16px;
        font-weight: 600;
        font-size: 0.9rem;
        color: var(--text);
        border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
        position: relative;
        transition: var(--transition);
      }
      .nav-menu > li > a::after {
        content: ""; position: absolute; left: 16px; right: 16px; bottom: 4px; height: 2px;
        background: var(--accent); border-radius: 2px;
        transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 0.25s ease;
      }
      .nav-menu > li > a:hover::after, .nav-menu > li.active > a::after { transform: scaleX(1); }
      .nav-menu > li > a:hover, .nav-menu > li.active > a { color: var(--accent); }
      
      .has-dd > a { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
      .dd-caret {
        display: inline-block;
        width: 7px; height: 7px;
        border-right: 2px solid currentColor; border-bottom: 2px solid currentColor;
        transform: rotate(45deg) translateY(-2px); transition: var(--transition);
        flex-shrink: 0;
      }
      .has-dd:hover .dd-caret { transform: rotate(225deg) translateY(-1px); }
      
      .dropdown {
        position: absolute; top: calc(100% + 12px); left: 50%;
        min-width: 280px; background: var(--white);
        border-radius: var(--radius);
        border: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06);
        box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
        padding: 12px 0;
        opacity: 0; visibility: hidden;
        transform: translate(-50%, 10px);
        transition: var(--transition);
      }
      .nav-menu li:hover .dropdown, .nav-menu li:focus-within .dropdown {
        opacity: 1; visibility: visible; transform: translate(-50%, 0);
      }
      .dropdown a {
        display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
        padding: 10px 20px; font-size: 0.88rem; font-weight: 500;
        color: var(--text); transition: var(--transition);
      }
      .dropdown a::before { content: "\203A"; color: var(--accent); font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.75rem; }
      .dropdown a:hover { background: var(--light); color: var(--accent); padding-left: 24px; }
      .dropdown .dd-title {
        padding: 8px 20px 4px; font-size: 0.7rem;
        text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.12em;
        color: var(--text-light); font-weight: 700;
      }
      
      .nav-cta {
        display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
        margin-left: 10px;
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent) 0%, var(--accent-dark) 100%) !important;
        color: var(--white) !important;
        padding: 10px 24px !important;
        border-radius: 999px;
        box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
        transition: var(--transition);
        font-weight: 700;
        font-size: 0.88rem;
      }
      .nav-cta:hover {
        transform: translateY(-2px);
        box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
        filter: brightness(1.05);
      }
      .mobile-top-links { display: none; }
      .nav-backdrop { display: none; }
      .drawer-head, .drawer-label { display: none; }
      .nav-ico { display: inline-block; width: 20px; height: 20px; flex-shrink: 0; color: var(--text-light); }
      .nav-cta::after { display: none; }
      
      .nav-toggle {
        display: none; background: none; border: none; cursor: pointer;
        padding: 8px; z-index: 1101; width: 44px; height: 44px;
        border-radius: var(--radius-sm); background: rgba(0,0,0,0.04);
        display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      }
      .nav-toggle span {
        display: block; width: 24px; height: 2px; background: var(--primary);
        margin: 4px 0; border-radius: 2px; transition: var(--transition);
      }
      .nav-toggle.open span:nth-child(1) { transform: translateY(7px) rotate(45deg); }
      .nav-toggle.open span:nth-child(2) { opacity: 0; }
      .nav-toggle.open span:nth-child(3) { transform: translateY(-7px) rotate(-45deg); }
      .nav-toggle.open span { background: var(--accent); }
      
      /* ============ HERO ============ */
      .hero {
        position: relative;
        min-height: 82vh;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        color: var(--white);
        overflow: hidden;
        padding: 60px 0;
        margin-bottom: 40px;
      }
      .hero-bg {
        position: absolute;
        inset: 0;
        z-index: -2;
      }
      .hero-bg img {
        width: 100%;
        height: 100%;
        object-fit: cover;
        transition: transform 8s ease;
      }
      .hero-slide.active .hero-bg img { transform: scale(1.05); }
      .hero-slides { position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -2; }
      .hero-slide {
        position: absolute;
        inset: 0;
        background-size: cover;
        background-position: center;
        opacity: 0;
        transition: opacity 1.4s ease;
      }
      .hero-slide.active { opacity: 1; }
      .hero-overlay {
        position: absolute;
        inset: 0;
        z-index: -1;
        background: linear-gradient(135deg,
          rgba(7, 20, 38, 0.85) 0%,
          rgba(11, 31, 58, 0.75) 40%,
          rgba(11, 31, 58, 0.55) 70%,
          rgba(7, 20, 38, 0.85) 100%);
      }
      .hero-content { max-width: 780px; position: relative; z-index: 3; padding: 20px 0; }
      .hero-kicker {
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 8px;
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
        backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
        color: var(--white);
        font-size: 0.75rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        letter-spacing: 0.18em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        padding: 8px 16px;
        border-radius: 999px;
        margin-bottom: 24px;
        border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
      }
      .hero-kicker::before {
        content: ""; width: 6px; height: 6px;
        background: var(--accent-light); border-radius: 50%;
      }
      .hero h1 {
        color: var(--white);
        font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 5vw, 4rem);
        font-weight: 800;
        margin-bottom: 20px;
        letter-spacing: -0.02em;
        line-height: 1.1;
      }
      .hero h1 em {
        font-style: normal;
        color: var(--accent-light);
        font-weight: 700;
      }
      .hero p {
        font-size: 1.1rem;
        color: #d1d9e3;
        margin-bottom: 32px;
        max-width: 640px;
        line-height: 1.7;
        font-weight: 400;
      }
      .hero-cta {
        display: flex;
        gap: 14px;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        margin-bottom: 40px;
      }
      .hero-stats-bar {
        position: absolute;
        left: 0;
        right: 0;
        bottom: 0;
        background: rgba(7, 20, 38, 0.82);
        backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
        border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
        padding: 16px 0;
      }
      .hero-stats {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr);
        gap: 16px;
        padding: 0;
      }
      .hero-caption {
        position: absolute;
        bottom: 28px;
        right: 32px;
        font-size: 0.75rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        letter-spacing: 0.16em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        color: var(--accent-light);
        background: rgba(7, 20, 38, 0.6);
        padding: 8px 18px;
        border-radius: 999px;
        border: 1px solid rgba(245, 179, 107, 0.35);
        backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
      }
      .hero-nav {
        position: absolute;
        top: 50%;
        transform: translateY(-50%);
        width: 52px;
        height: 52px;
        border-radius: 50%;
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
        border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3);
        color: var(--white);
        font-size: 1.4rem;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        cursor: pointer;
        z-index: 30;
        transition: var(--transition);
        backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
        pointer-events: auto;
      }
      .hero-nav:hover {
        background: var(--accent-light);
        border-color: var(--accent-light);
        color: var(--primary-dark);
        transform: translateY(-50%) scale(1.1);
      }
      .hero-nav:active { transform: translateY(-50%) scale(0.92); }
      .hero-prev { left: 32px; }
      .hero-next { right: 32px; }
      .hs {
        text-align: center;
        border-right: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      }
      .hs:last-child { border-right: 0; }
      .hs .num {
        font-family: var(--font-head);
        font-weight: 800;
        font-size: 1.6rem;
        color: var(--accent-light);
        line-height: 1.2;
      }
      .hs .label {
        font-size: 0.68rem;
        letter-spacing: 0.08em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        color: #9fb0c3;
      }
      
      /* ============ VIDEO CTA ============ */
      .section-video {
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary-dark) 0%, var(--primary) 100%);
        position: relative;
        overflow: hidden;
      }
      .section-video::before {
        content: "";
        position: absolute;
        top: -10%; right: -10%;
        width: 400px; height: 400px;
        background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(224, 134, 43, 0.1) 0%, transparent 60%);
        pointer-events: none;
      }
      .video-cta {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: space-between;
        gap: 40px;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
      }
      .video-cta-text {
        flex: 1;
        min-width: 260px;
        position: relative;
        z-index: 2;
      }
      .video-cta-text h2 {
        color: var(--white);
        font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 3vw, 2rem);
        margin-bottom: 14px;
        font-weight: 800;
      }
      .video-cta-text p {
        color: #c3cfdd;
        margin-bottom: 24px;
        max-width: 520px;
        line-height: 1.7;
        font-size: 0.98rem;
      }
      .video-cta-play {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 14px;
        padding: 32px;
        border-radius: 24px;
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
        border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
        backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
        transition: var(--transition);
        position: relative;
        z-index: 2;
        width: 200px;
        height: 200px;
        flex-shrink: 0;
      }
      .video-cta-play::before {
        content: "";
        position: absolute;
        inset: 0;
        border-radius: 24px;
        padding: 2px;
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent-light), var(--accent));
        -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(#fff 0 0) content-box, linear-gradient(#fff 0 0);
        -webkit-mask-composite: destination-out;
        mask-composite: exclude;
        pointer-events: none;
        transition: var(--transition);
      }
      .video-cta-play:hover {
        transform: translateY(-4px);
        border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3);
        box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(224, 134, 43, 0.25);
      }
      .video-cta-play .play-icon {
        width: 48px;
        height: 48px;
        border-radius: 50%;
        background: var(--white);
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);
        z-index: 3;
        position: relative;
      }
      .video-cta-play .play-icon::after {
        content: "";
        width: 0;
        height: 0;
        border-top: 9px solid transparent;
        border-bottom: 9px solid transparent;
        border-left: 14px solid var(--primary-dark);
        margin-left: 3px;
      }
      .video-cta-play .play-label {
        color: var(--white);
        font-weight: 700;
        letter-spacing: 0.1em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        font-size: 0.8rem;
        z-index: 3;
        position: relative;
      }
      .video-cta-play:hover .play-label { color: var(--accent-light); }
      
      /* ============ AT A GLANCE ============ */
      .glance-grid {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
        gap: 28px;
        margin-bottom: 44px;
      }
      .glance-card {
        background: var(--white);
        border: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04);
        border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
        padding: 32px 26px;
        box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
        transition: var(--transition);
        text-align: center;
      }
      .glance-card:hover {
        transform: translateY(-8px);
        box-shadow: var(--shadow-xl);
        border-color: rgba(224, 134, 43, 0.15);
      }
      .glance-card img {
        width: 80px;
        height: 80px;
        object-fit: contain;
        margin: 0 auto 20px;
        filter: grayscale(0.2);
        transition: var(--transition);
      }
      .glance-card:hover img { filter: none; transform: scale(1.1); }
      .glance-card h3 {
        font-size: 1.1rem;
        margin-bottom: 10px;
        color: var(--text);
      }
      .glance-card p {
        font-size: 0.92rem;
        color: var(--text-light);
        line-height: 1.6;
      }
      .cert-strip { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 26px; flex-wrap: wrap; padding: 22px 28px; background: var(--light); border-radius: var(--radius); }
      .cert-label { font-family: var(--font-head); font-weight: 700; color: var(--primary); letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 0.8rem; }
      .cert-logos { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 24px; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: center; }
      .cert-logos img { height: 44px; width: auto; max-width: 150px; object-fit: contain; filter: grayscale(0.3); opacity: 0.85; transition: all 0.25s; }
      .cert-logos img:hover { filter: none; opacity: 1; }
      
      /* ============ BUTTONS ============ */
      .btn {
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        gap: 8px;
        padding: 12px 28px;
        border-radius: 999px;
        font-weight: 700;
        font-size: 0.9rem;
        transition: var(--transition);
        cursor: pointer;
        border: none;
        gap: 8px;
      }
      .btn-primary {
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent) 0%, var(--accent-dark) 100%);
        color: var(--white);
        box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(224, 134, 43, 0.3);
      }
      .btn-primary:hover {
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent-light) 0%, var(--accent) 100%);
        color: var(--white);
        transform: translateY(-3px);
        box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(224, 134, 43, 0.4);
      }
      .btn-outline {
        border: 2px solid rgba(11, 31, 58, 0.15);
        color: var(--text);
        background: var(--white);
        box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      }
      .btn-outline:hover {
        background: var(--primary-dark);
        color: var(--white);
        border-color: var(--primary-dark);
        transform: translateY(-2px);
        box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      }
      .btn-dark {
        background: var(--primary-dark);
        color: var(--white);
        box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      }
      .btn-dark:hover {
        background: var(--primary-light);
        color: var(--white);
        transform: translateY(-2px);
        box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      }
      .btn-light {
        background: var(--light);
        color: var(--primary);
        box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      }
      .btn-light:hover {
        background: var(--primary-dark);
        color: var(--white);
        transform: translateY(-2px);
      }
      
      /* ============ SECTIONS ============ */
      .section { padding: 100px 0; position: relative; }
      .section-light { background: var(--light); }
      .section-primary { background: var(--primary-dark); color: var(--white); }
      .section-primary h2, .section-primary h3 { color: var(--white); }
      
      .section-head {
        text-align: center;
        max-width: 780px;
        margin: 0 auto 60px;
        position: relative;
      }
      .section-head::after {
        content: "";
        position: absolute;
        bottom: -16px;
        left: 50%;
        transform: translateX(-50%);
        width: 60px;
        height: 4px;
        background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent), var(--accent-light));
        border-radius: 2px;
      }
      .kicker {
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 8px;
        color: var(--accent);
        font-weight: 800;
        font-size: 0.75rem;
        letter-spacing: 0.18em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        margin-bottom: 16px;
        position: relative;
      }
      .kicker::before {
        content: ""; width: 8px; height: 8px;
        background: var(--accent-light); border-radius: 50%;
      }
      .section-head h2 {
        font-size: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3rem);
        font-weight: 800;
        letter-spacing: -0.02em;
        margin-bottom: 16px;
      }
      .section-head p {
        color: var(--text-light);
        font-size: 1.05rem;
        line-height: 1.7;
        margin-top: 12px;
      }
      
      /* ============ STATS ============ */
      .stats {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr));
        gap: 24px;
        margin-top: 40px;
      }
      .stat {
        background: var(--white);
        border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
        padding: 32px 24px;
        text-align: center;
        box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
        border: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04);
        transition: var(--transition);
        position: relative;
        overflow: hidden;
      }
      .stat::before {
        content: "";
        position: absolute;
        top: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
        height: 4px;
        background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent), var(--accent-light));
      }
      .stat:hover {
        transform: translateY(-8px);
        box-shadow: var(--shadow-xl);
        border-color: rgba(224, 134, 43, 0.2);
      }
      .stat .num {
        font-family: var(--font-head);
        font-size: 2.8rem;
        font-weight: 800;
        color: var(--primary-dark);
        line-height: 1.1;
      }
      .stat .label {
        color: var(--text-light);
        font-size: 0.9rem;
        margin-top: 10px;
        font-weight: 500;
      }
      .stat-primary {
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary-dark) 0%, var(--primary) 100%);
        border-top-color: var(--accent);
        color: var(--white);
      }
      .stat-primary .num { color: var(--accent-light); }
      .stat-primary .label { color: #c3cfdd; }
      
      /* ============ CARDS / GRIDS ============ */
      .grid { display: grid; gap: 28px; }
      .grid-2 { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
      .grid-3 { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
      .grid-4 { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); }
      
      .card {
        background: var(--white);
        border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
        overflow: hidden;
        border: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04);
        box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
        transition: var(--transition);
      }
      .card:hover {
        transform: translateY(-10px);
        box-shadow: var(--shadow-xl);
        border-color: rgba(224, 134, 43, 0.15);
      }
      .card-img {
        overflow: hidden;
        aspect-ratio: 4/3;
        background: var(--light-2);
      }
      .card-img img {
        width: 100%;
        height: 100%;
        object-fit: cover;
        transition: transform 0.5s ease;
      }
      .card:hover .card-img img { transform: scale(1.07); }
      .card-body { padding: 26px; }
      .card-body h3 {
        font-size: 1.15rem;
        margin-bottom: 10px;
        color: var(--text);
      }
      .card-body p {
        color: var(--text-light);
        font-size: 0.93rem;
        line-height: 1.65;
      }
      
      /* feature card (icon) */
      .feature-card {
        text-align: center;
        padding: 40px 24px;
        background: var(--white);
        border: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04);
        border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
        box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
        transition: var(--transition);
      }
      .feature-icon {
        width: 72px;
        height: 72px;
        margin: 0 auto 20px;
        border-radius: 18px;
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary-dark) 0%, var(--primary-light) 100%);
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        color: var(--accent-light);
        font-size: 1.8rem;
        box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(11, 31, 58, 0.2);
      }
      .feature-card h3 {
        font-size: 1.1rem;
        margin-bottom: 12px;
        color: var(--text);
      }
      .feature-card p {
        color: var(--text-light);
        font-size: 0.92rem;
        line-height: 1.6;
      }
      .feature-card:hover {
        transform: translateY(-8px);
        box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
        border-color: rgba(224, 134, 43, 0.15);
      }
      
      /* ============ PROCESS FLOW ============ */
      .flow {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(6, 1fr);
        gap: 16px;
      }
      .flow-item {
        background: var(--white);
        border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
        text-align: center;
        padding: 24px 12px;
        box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
        border: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04);
        transition: var(--transition);
      }
      .flow-item:hover {
        transform: translateY(-6px);
        box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
        border-color: rgba(224, 134, 43, 0.15);
      }
      .flow-item .step {
        width: 44px;
        height: 44px;
        line-height: 44px;
        border-radius: 50%;
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary-dark) 0%, var(--primary-light) 100%);
        color: var(--white);
        font-weight: 800;
        font-size: 0.9rem;
        margin: 0 auto 14px;
        font-family: var(--font-head);
        box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(11, 31, 58, 0.2);
      }
      .flow-item h4 {
        font-size: 0.85rem;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        letter-spacing: 0.06em;
        color: var(--text);
        margin-bottom: 0;
      }
      
      /* ============ TABS ============ */
      .tabs {
        display: flex;
        gap: 4px;
        flex-wrap: nowrap;
        justify-content: flex-start;
        margin-bottom: 36px;
        padding: 6px;
        background: var(--light);
        border: 1px solid var(--light-2);
        border-radius: 14px;
        overflow-x: auto;
        scrollbar-width: none;
        -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
      }
      .tabs::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
      .tab-btn {
        padding: 11px 22px;
        border-radius: 10px;
        border: 0;
        background: transparent;
        font-weight: 700;
        font-size: 0.9rem;
        color: var(--text-light);
        cursor: pointer;
        transition: all 0.22s;
        white-space: nowrap;
        position: relative;
      }
      .tab-btn:hover { color: var(--primary); background: rgba(15, 42, 67, 0.06); }
      .tab-btn.active {
        background: var(--white);
        color: var(--primary);
        box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      }
      .tab-btn.active::after {
        content: "";
        position: absolute;
        left: 16px;
        right: 16px;
        bottom: -1px;
        height: 3px;
        border-radius: 3px 3px 0 0;
        background: var(--accent);
      }
      .tab-panel { display: none; animation: fadeIn 0.4s ease; }
      .tab-panel.active { display: block; }
      @keyframes fadeIn { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(10px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }
      
      @media (max-width: 640px) {
        .tabs { margin-inline: -6px; border-radius: 12px; padding: 5px; }
        .tab-btn { padding: 10px 16px; font-size: 0.85rem; }
      }
      
      /* ============ PROJECTS ============ */
      .project-card .card-body h3 { font-size: 0.98rem; }
      .project-card .card-body p { font-size: 0.85rem; }
      
      /* ============ PAGE HERO ============ */
      .page-hero { position: relative; padding: 90px 0 60px; color: var(--white); background: var(--primary); overflow: hidden; }
      .page-hero::after { content: ""; position: absolute; right: -10%; top: -60%; width: 500px; height: 500px; border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(217, 123, 31, 0.35), transparent 70%); }
      .page-hero h1 { color: var(--white); font-size: clamp(1.9rem, 3.6vw, 2.8rem); font-weight: 800; }
      .page-hero .kicker { color: var(--accent-light); }
      .page-hero p { color: #cbd6e2; max-width: 640px; margin-top: 10px; }
      .crumbs { position: absolute; top: 22px; right: 5%; font-size: 0.82rem; color: #9fb0c3; }
      .crumbs a { color: #9fb0c3; }
      .crumbs a:hover { color: var(--accent-light); }
      
      /* ============ PAGE INTRO ============ */
      .page-intro { padding: 70px 0 0; }
      .page-intro .container { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.1fr 1fr; gap: 48px; align-items: center; }
      .page-intro img { border-radius: var(--radius); box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); height: 100%; object-fit: cover; }
      .page-intro h2 { font-size: 1.9rem; margin-bottom: 16px; }
      .page-intro p { color: var(--text-light); margin-bottom: 14px; }
      
      /* ============ FEATURES LIST ============ */
      .check-list { list-style: none; }
      .check-list li { padding: 8px 0 8px 32px; position: relative; color: var(--text); }
      .check-list li::before { content: "\\2713"; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 8px; color: var(--accent); font-weight: 800; }
      
      /* ============ INFO TABLE ============ */
      .table-wrap { overflow-x: auto; background: var(--white); border-radius: var(--radius); box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); }
      table.data { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 0.92rem; }
      table.data th { background: var(--primary); color: var(--white); text-align: left; padding: 13px 16px; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; }
      table.data td { padding: 11px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--light-2); }
      table.data tbody tr:hover { background: var(--light); }
      table.data td.num, table.data th.num { text-align: right; }
      
      /* ============ TEAM ============ */
      .team-card { text-align: center; padding: 0 0 24px; }
      .team-card .card-img { aspect-ratio: 4/5; min-height: 280px; }
      .team-card .card-img img { object-fit: cover; width: 100%; height: 100%; }
      .team-card h3 { font-size: 1.15rem; margin: 16px 12px 2px; }
      .team-card .role { color: var(--accent); font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.9rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; }
      .team-card p.bio { padding: 10px 18px 0; color: var(--text-light); font-size: 0.87rem; }
      
      /* ============ JOB CARD ============ */
      .job { background: var(--white); border-radius: var(--radius); box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); padding: 30px; margin-bottom: 28px; border-left: 5px solid var(--accent); }
      .job h3 { font-size: 1.25rem; margin-bottom: 6px; }
      .job .meta { display: flex; gap: 18px; flex-wrap: wrap; font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--text-light); margin-bottom: 14px; }
      .job .meta span b { color: var(--primary); }
      .job h4 { font-size: 1rem; margin: 18px 0 8px; color: var(--primary); }
      .job ul { padding-left: 20px; color: var(--text); font-size: 0.94rem; }
      .job ul li { margin-bottom: 5px; }
      
      /* ============ DEALER TABLE ============ */
      .dealer-filters { display: flex; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 24px; }
      .dealer-filters .btn { font-size: 0.82rem; padding: 8px 18px; }
      .filter-btn.active { background: var(--accent); border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--white); }
      
      /* ============ FILTER PILLS ============ */
      .filter-block { margin-bottom: 24px; }
      .filter-label {
        display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px;
        font-size: 0.68rem; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase;
        color: var(--text-light); font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 12px;
      }
      .filter-label::after { content: ''; flex: 1; height: 1px; background: var(--light-2); }
      .pill-row { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
      .pill {
        display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
        padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 999px;
        border: 1px solid var(--light-2); background: var(--white);
        color: var(--text); font-size: 0.84rem; font-weight: 600;
        font-family: var(--font); cursor: pointer;
        transition: var(--transition); white-space: nowrap;
      }
      .pill:hover { border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--accent); transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); }
      .pill.active { background: var(--primary); border-color: var(--primary); color: var(--white); box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); }
      .pill .pill-count {
        font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 700; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 999px;
        background: var(--light); color: var(--text-light);
      }
      .pill.active .pill-count { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); color: var(--white); }
      
      .dealer-search-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 20px; }
      .dealer-search {
        display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
        padding: 0 18px; border: 1px solid var(--light-2); border-radius: 999px;
        background: var(--white); min-width: 320px; flex: 0 1 420px;
        transition: var(--transition);
      }
      .dealer-search:focus-within { border-color: var(--accent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(224, 134, 43, 0.12); }
      .dealer-search i { color: var(--text-light); font-size: 0.85rem; }
      .dealer-search input {
        border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; padding: 11px 0;
        font-size: 0.92rem; font-family: var(--font); color: var(--text); width: 100%;
      }
      .dealer-search input::placeholder { color: var(--text-light); }
      
      .dealer-summary {
        display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap;
        font-size: 0.86rem; color: var(--text-light); margin-bottom: 14px;
      }
      .dealer-summary b { color: var(--primary); font-weight: 700; }
      .dealer-summary .chip {
        display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
        background: rgba(224, 134, 43, 0.1); color: var(--accent-dark);
        padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 999px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.78rem;
      }
      .dealer-summary .chip button {
        background: none; border: 0; cursor: pointer; color: inherit;
        font-size: 0.9rem; line-height: 1; padding: 0;
      }
      .dealer-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 0.9rem; }
      .dealer-table th {
        text-align: left; padding: 13px 16px; background: var(--primary);
        color: var(--white); font-size: 0.74rem; letter-spacing: 0.1em;
        text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: 700; white-space: nowrap;
      }
      .dealer-table th:first-child { border-radius: 10px 0 0 0; }
      .dealer-table th:last-child { border-radius: 0 10px 0 0; }
      .dealer-table td { padding: 14px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--light-2); vertical-align: top; }
      .dealer-table tbody tr { transition: var(--transition); }
      .dealer-table tbody tr:hover { background: var(--light); }
      .dealer-table .num { white-space: nowrap; }
      .dealer-table .area-tag {
        display: inline-block; background: var(--light); color: var(--primary);
        padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 0.74rem; font-weight: 700;
        margin-bottom: 6px; white-space: nowrap;
      }
      .dealer-table .addr { color: var(--text-light); font-size: 0.84rem; line-height: 1.5; }
      .dealer-table .actions { display: flex; gap: 6px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
      @media (max-width: 760px) {
        .dealer-table th:nth-child(3), .dealer-table td:nth-child(3) { display: none; }
        .dealer-search { min-width: 0; flex: 1 1 100%; }
      }
      
      /* ============ CONTACT ============ */
      .contact-cards { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: 24px; }
      .contact-card { background: var(--white); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 30px; box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); }
      .contact-card h3 { font-size: 1.15rem; margin-bottom: 14px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }
      .contact-card h3 .ci { width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 10px; background: rgba(217, 123, 31, 0.12); color: var(--accent); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-shrink: 0; }
      .contact-card p, .contact-card a { color: var(--text-light); font-size: 0.95rem; }
      .contact-card a:hover { color: var(--accent); }
      
      /* ============ DEALER MODAL CONTACT CARDS ============ */
      .contact-card-list {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: 12px;
      }
      .contact-card {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 16px;
        padding: 14px 18px;
        border-radius: 12px;
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
        border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
        transition: var(--transition);
      }
      .contact-card:hover {
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
        border-color: rgba(224, 134, 43, 0.25);
        transform: translateY(-2px);
      }
      .contact-info { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
      .contact-name {
        display: block;
        font-size: 0.95rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        color: var(--white);
        margin-bottom: 2px;
      }
      .contact-person {
        font-size: 0.82rem;
        color: #a3b2c4;
        margin-bottom: 4px;
      }
      .contact-address {
        font-size: 0.8rem;
        color: #8fa0b5;
        line-height: 1.5;
        max-width: 340px;
      }
      .contact-actions {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: 8px;
        flex-shrink: 0;
      }
      .btn-call {
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 6px;
        padding: 8px 14px;
        font-size: 0.82rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        color: var(--accent-light);
        background: rgba(224, 134, 43, 0.12);
        border: 1px solid var(--accent);
        border-radius: 10px;
        text-decoration: none;
        white-space: nowrap;
        transition: var(--transition);
      }
      .btn-call:hover {
        background: var(--accent);
        color: var(--white);
        border-color: var(--accent-light);
      }
      .btn-whatsapp {
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 6px;
        padding: 8px 14px;
        font-size: 0.82rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        color: #25d366;
        background: rgba(37, 211, 102, 0.10);
        border: 1px solid rgba(37, 211, 102, 0.35);
        border-radius: 10px;
        text-decoration: none;
        white-space: nowrap;
        transition: var(--transition);
      }
      .btn-whatsapp:hover {
        background: #25d366;
        color: var(--white);
        border-color: #25d366;
      }
      .other-contact {
        font-size: 0.88rem;
        font-weight: 600;
        color: #c3cfdd;
        padding: 6px 0;
        text-decoration: none;
        transition: var(--transition);
      }
      .other-contact:hover { color: var(--accent-light); }
      
      /* ============ DEALER TABLE ACTION BUTTONS ============ */
      .btn-call-sm {
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 4px;
        padding: 5px 10px;
        font-size: 0.78rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        color: var(--accent-light);
        background: rgba(224, 134, 43, 0.12);
        border: 1px solid var(--accent);
        border-radius: 8px;
        text-decoration: none;
        white-space: nowrap;
        transition: var(--transition);
      }
      .btn-call-sm:hover {
        background: var(--accent);
        color: var(--white);
        border-color: var(--accent-light);
      }
      .btn-whatsapp-sm {
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 4px;
        padding: 5px 10px;
        font-size: 0.78rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        color: #25d366;
        background: rgba(37, 211, 102, 0.10);
        border: 1px solid rgba(37, 211, 102, 0.35);
        border-radius: 8px;
        text-decoration: none;
        white-space: nowrap;
        transition: var(--transition);
      }
      .btn-whatsapp-sm:hover {
        background: #25d366;
        color: var(--white);
        border-color: #25d366;
      }
      
      /* ============ FOOTER ============ */
      .footer {
        width: 100%;
        background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--primary-dark) 0%, var(--primary) 100%);
        color: #c3cfdd;
        padding: 80px 0 0;
        position: relative;
        overflow: hidden;
      }
      .footer .container,
      .footer-bottom .container {
        max-width: none;
        padding: 0 40px;
        width: 100%;
      }
      .footer::before {
        content: "";
        position: absolute;
        top: -50%; left: -50%;
        width: 200%; height: 200%;
        background: radial-gradient(circle at 30% 30%, rgba(224, 134, 43, 0.06) 0%, transparent 50%);
        pointer-events: none;
      }
      .footer-grid {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: 1.4fr 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr 1.2fr;
        gap: 36px;
        padding-bottom: 50px;
        position: relative;
        z-index: 2;
      }
      .footer h4 {
        color: var(--white);
        font-size: 0.9rem;
        margin-bottom: 22px;
        letter-spacing: 0.05em;
        font-weight: 700;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        position: relative;
        display: inline-block;
      }
      .footer h4::after {
        content: "";
        position: absolute;
        bottom: -6px; left: 0;
        width: 20px; height: 2px;
        background: var(--accent-light);
        border-radius: 2px;
      }
      .footer a { color: #c3cfdd; transition: var(--transition); }
      .footer a:hover { color: var(--accent-light); padding-left: 4px; }
      .footer ul { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0; }
      .footer ul li { margin-bottom: 12px; font-size: 0.92rem; }
      .footer ul li.addr { line-height: 1.6; color: #a3b2c4; }
      .footer ul li.addr strong { color: var(--white); font-weight: 600; }
      .footer-brand img { height: 44px; width: auto; margin-bottom: 18px; filter: drop-shadow(0 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)); }
      .footer-tag {
        font-size: 0.75rem;
        letter-spacing: 0.14em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        color: var(--white);
        margin-bottom: 16px;
        font-weight: 700;
      }
      .footer-tag strong { color: var(--accent-light); }
      .footer-desc {
        font-size: 0.88rem;
        line-height: 1.7;
        margin-bottom: 20px;
        color: #a3b2c4;
      }
      .footer-social {
        display: flex;
        gap: 12px;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        margin-top: 8px;
      }
      .footer-social a {
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        width: 40px;
        height: 40px;
        border-radius: 12px;
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
        border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
        color: var(--white);
        font-size: 18px;
        transition: var(--transition);
      }
      .footer-social a i {
        font-family: 'Font Awesome 6 Brands';
        font-weight: 400;
        font-style: normal;
      }
      .footer-social a:hover {
        background: var(--accent-light);
        border-color: var(--accent-light);
        color: var(--primary-dark);
        transform: translateY(-3px);
        box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(245, 179, 107, 0.3);
      }
      .footer-bottom {
        border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
        padding: 26px 0;
        font-size: 0.85rem;
        color: #8fa0b5;
        position: relative;
        z-index: 2;
      }
      .footer-bottom .container {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: space-between;
        gap: 16px;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        text-align: center;
      }
      .footer-links a {
        color: #8fa0b5;
        margin: 0 8px;
        font-size: 0.85rem;
      }
      .footer-links a:hover { color: var(--accent-light); }
      .footer-copy, .footer-credit { line-height: 1.6; }
      
      /* ============ NEWSLETTER ============ */
      .newsletter {
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary-dark) 0%, var(--primary) 100%);
        border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
        padding: 44px 40px;
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: 1.3fr 1fr;
        gap: 30px;
        align-items: center;
        margin-top: 70px;
        color: var(--white);
        position: relative;
        overflow: hidden;
        box-shadow: var(--shadow-xl);
      }
      .newsletter::before {
        content: "";
        position: absolute;
        top: -50%; right: -20%;
        width: 300px; height: 300px;
        background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(224, 134, 43, 0.15) 0%, transparent 70%);
        pointer-events: none;
      }
      .newsletter h2 {
        color: var(--white);
        font-size: 1.7rem;
        margin-bottom: 8px;
        font-weight: 800;
      }
      .newsletter p { color: #c3cfdd; font-size: 0.95rem; margin-bottom: 0; }
      .newsletter .nl-form { display: flex; }
      .newsletter input[type="email"] {
        padding: 14px 20px;
        border: none;
        border-radius: 10px 0 0 10px;
        width: 100%;
        font-size: 0.95rem;
        color: var(--text);
        box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
      }
      .newsletter input[type="email"]::placeholder { color: #a3b2c4; }
      .newsletter button {
        border: none;
        border-radius: 0 10px 10px 0;
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent) 0%, var(--accent-dark) 100%);
        color: var(--white);
        padding: 14px 26px;
        font-weight: 700;
        cursor: pointer;
        transition: var(--transition);
      }
      .newsletter button:hover {
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent-light) 0%, var(--accent) 100%);
        transform: translateY(-2px);
        box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(224, 134, 43, 0.3);
      }
      
      /* ============ MEDIA GALLERY ============ */
      .gallery {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
        gap: 18px;
      }
      .gallery-item {
        position: relative;
        border-radius: var(--radius);
        overflow: hidden;
        cursor: pointer;
        aspect-ratio: 4/3;
        background: var(--light-2);
        box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
        transition: var(--transition);
      }
      .gallery-item:hover {
        transform: translateY(-4px);
        box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
      }
      .gallery-item img {
        width: 100%;
        height: 100%;
        object-fit: cover;
        transition: transform 0.5s ease;
      }
      .gallery-item:hover img { transform: scale(1.1); }
      .gallery-item .cap {
        position: absolute;
        inset: auto 0 0 0;
        background: linear-gradient(transparent, rgba(7, 20, 38, 0.85));
        color: var(--white);
        padding: 20px 16px 12px;
        font-size: 0.85rem;
      }
      
      /* ============ MODAL / LIGHTBOX ============ */
      .modal { position: fixed; inset: 0; background: rgba(10, 29, 48, 0.92); z-index: 2000; display: none; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 24px; }
      .modal.open { display: flex; }
```

```
  content: |
      <script setup lang="ts">
      import { computed, nextTick, onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, ref, watch } from 'vue'
      import { useRoute } from 'vue-router'
      
      const route = useRoute()
      const isOpen = ref(false)
      const openSection = ref('')
      const desktopDd = ref('')
      const scrolled = ref(false)
      
      const pageName = computed(() => (route.path === '/' ? 'index.html' : route.path.replace(/^\//, '') + '.html'))
      
      const sectionPaths: Record<string, string[]> = {
        products: ['products-architectural', 'products-industrial', 'products-furniture', 'products-hardware', 'products-electrical', 'products-others', 'online-catalogue', 'catalogue'],
        projects: ['projects-image', 'projects-list', 'projects-video'],
        manufacturing: ['manufacturing-billet-casting', 'manufacturing-extrusion-presses', 'manufacturing-aging-tempering-oven', 'manufacturing-anodizing-section', 'manufacturing-powder-coating-plant', 'manufacturing-wooden-finish', 'manufacturing-quality-inspection', 'manufacturing-packaging', 'manufacturing-warehousing-and-delivery', 'manufacturing-etp'],
        investors: ['board-of-directors']
      }
      
      function isActive(to: string) {
        if (to === '/') return route.path === '/'
        return route.path === to
      }
      
      function sectionHasPage(section: string) {
        return (sectionPaths[section] || []).some((p) => pageName.value === p + '.html')
      }
      
      watch(pageName, () => {
        for (const s of Object.keys(sectionPaths)) {
          if (sectionHasPage(s)) {
            openSection.value = s
            return
          }
        }
        openSection.value = ''
      }, { immediate: true })
      
      function onMenuCapture(e: MouseEvent) {
        if (window.innerWidth > 820) return
        const el = (e.target as HTMLElement | null)?.closest('[data-accordion]') as HTMLElement | null
        if (!el) return
        const name = el.getAttribute('data-accordion') || ''
        if (openSection.value !== name) {
          e.preventDefault()
          e.stopPropagation()
          openSection.value = name
        }
      }
      
      function openMenu() {
        isOpen.value = true
        document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden'
        nextTick(() => {
          const close = document.querySelector('.drawer-close') as HTMLButtonElement | null
          close?.focus()
        })
      }
      
      function closeMenu() {
        isOpen.value = false
        document.body.style.overflow = ''
      }
      
      function closeMenus() {
        closeMenu()
        openSection.value = ''
        desktopDd.value = ''
        const active = document.activeElement as HTMLElement | null
        if (active && typeof active.blur === 'function') active.blur()
      }
      
      function onNavEnter(name: string) {
        if (window.innerWidth > 820) desktopDd.value = name
      }
      
      function onNavLeave() {
        if (window.innerWidth > 820) desktopDd.value = ''
      }
      
      function clearNavDd() {
        if (window.innerWidth > 820) desktopDd.value = ''
      }
      
      watch(() => route.fullPath, () => {
        closeMenu()
        openSection.value = ''
        desktopDd.value = ''
      })
      
      function onKeydown(e: KeyboardEvent) {
        if (e.key === 'Escape') closeMenu()
      }
      
      function onResize() {
        if (window.innerWidth > 820) {
          if (isOpen.value) closeMenu()
          openSection.value = ''
        } else {
          desktopDd.value = ''
        }
      }
      
      function onScroll() {
        scrolled.value = window.scrollY > 10
      }
      
      onMounted(() => {
        window.addEventListener('keydown', onKeydown)
        window.addEventListener('resize', onResize)
        window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll)
        onScroll()
      })
      
      onBeforeUnmount(() => {
        window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeydown)
        window.removeEventListener('resize', onResize)
        window.removeEventListener('scroll', onScroll)
        document.body.style.overflow = ''
      })
      </script>
      
      <template>

          <header class="header" :class="{ scrolled }">

- path: app\layouts\default.vue
  content: |
      <script setup lang="ts">
      import { useModal } from '~/composables/useModal'
      import { wirePageInteractions } from '~/composables/useLegacyInteractions'
      import { watch, onMounted, nextTick } from 'vue'
      
      const { state } = useModal()
      const route = useRoute()
      
      watch(() => state.lightbox.open || state.pdf.open || state.video.open, (anyOpen) => {
        document.body.style.overflow = anyOpen ? 'hidden' : ''
      })
      
      onMounted(() => wirePageInteractions())
      watch(() => route.fullPath, () => nextTick(() => wirePageInteractions()))
      
      function onKeydown(e: KeyboardEvent) {
        if (e.key === 'Escape') {
          state.lightbox.open = false
          state.pdf.open = false
          state.video.open = false
        }
      }
      
      onMounted(() => window.addEventListener('keydown', onKeydown))
      onBeforeUnmount(() => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeydown))
      </script>
      
      <template>
        <div class="site">
          <SiteHeader />
          <main>
            <slot />
          </main>
          <SiteFooter />
          <LightboxModal />
          <PdfModal />
          <VideoModal />
        </div>
      </template>
      
- path: app\composables\useModal.ts
  content: |
      import { reactive } from 'vue'
      
      const state = reactive({
        lightbox: { open: false, src: '', alt: '', cap: '' },
        pdf: { open: false, title: 'Document', src: '' },
        video: { open: false, id: '', title: 'Video' }
      })
      
      export function useModal() {
        function openLightbox(src: string, cap = '', alt = '') {
          state.lightbox.src = src
          state.lightbox.cap = cap
          state.lightbox.alt = alt || cap || ''
          state.lightbox.open = true
        }
        function openPdf(src: string, title = 'Document') {
          state.pdf.src = src
          state.pdf.title = title
          state.pdf.open = true
        }
        function openVideo(id: string, title = 'Video') {
          state.video.id = id
          state.video.title = title
          state.video.open = true
        }
        function closeLightbox() {
          state.lightbox.open = false
          state.lightbox.src = ''
        }
        function closePdf() {
          state.pdf.open = false
          state.pdf.src = ''
        }
        function closeVideo() {
          state.video.open = false
          state.video.id = ''
        }
        return { state, openLightbox, openPdf, openVideo, closeLightbox, closePdf, closeVideo }
      }
      
      export function videoEmbedUrl(id: string) {
        return (
          'https://www.youtube.com/embed/' + id +
          '?autoplay=0&loop=0&showinfo=0&theme=dark&color=red&controls=1&modestbranding=0&start=0&fs=1&iv_load_policy=1&wmode=transparent&rel=1'
        )
      }
- path: app\composables\useLegacyInteractions.ts
  content: |
      import { useModal } from '~/composables/useModal'
      
      let wired = false
      
      function isMobileViewport() {
        return window.matchMedia('(max-width: 820px)').matches || ('ontouchstart' in window && window.innerWidth <= 820)
      }
      
      export function wirePageInteractions() {
        const { openLightbox, openVideo, openPdf } = useModal()
        const year = String(new Date().getFullYear())
      
        document.querySelectorAll('[data-year]').forEach((el) => {
          el.textContent = year
        })
      
        if (!wired) {
          wired = true
      
          document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            const target = e.target as HTMLElement | null
            if (!target || !target.closest) return
      
            const lb = target.closest('[data-lightbox]') as HTMLElement | null
            if (lb) {
              const img = lb.querySelector('img')
              if (img) openLightbox(img.getAttribute('src') || '', lb.getAttribute('data-caption') || '', img.getAttribute('alt') || '')
              return
            }
      
            const thumb = target.closest('.video-thumb') as HTMLElement | null
            if (thumb) {
              openVideo(thumb.getAttribute('data-video') || '', thumb.getAttribute('data-title') || 'Video')
              return
            }
      
            const tabBtn = target.closest('.tab-btn') as HTMLElement | null
            if (tabBtn && tabBtn.closest('[data-tabs]')) {
              const wrap = tabBtn.closest('[data-tabs]') as HTMLElement
              wrap.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach((b) => b.classList.remove('active'))
              wrap.querySelectorAll('.tab-panel').forEach((p) => p.classList.remove('active'))
              tabBtn.classList.add('active')
              const panel = document.getElementById(tabBtn.getAttribute('data-tab') || '')
              if (panel) panel.classList.add('active')
              return
            }
      
            const pdfLink = target.closest('a[href$=".pdf"]') as HTMLAnchorElement | null
            if (pdfLink && !pdfLink.closest('.modal')) {
              if (isMobileViewport()) {
                pdfLink.setAttribute('target', '_blank')
                pdfLink.setAttribute('rel', 'noopener')
                return
              }
              e.preventDefault()
              openPdf(
                pdfLink.getAttribute('href') || '',
                pdfLink.getAttribute('data-pdf-title') || (pdfLink.textContent || '').trim() || 'Document'
              )
              return
            }
          })
        }
      }
```
